title: Matrix stiffness transcriptomic responses and osteoporosis: reproducible meta-analysis
description: Code, dated protocols, systematic-search records and derived results for a study-clustered transcriptomic meta-analysis of matrix stiffness responses. Version 1.1 adds chronological leave-future-out validation and an independent 11-donor, four-tissue human MSC atlas. The analyses define the limits of cross-study, tissue and osteoporosis-cohort transfer and do not constitute a diagnostic test.
